message:
fix: remove deprecated areas field from project configuration

WHY
The areas field in ProjectConfig was redundant and complicated the configuration logic, as path-based classification is now handled via PathTypes and Excluded rules. It required manual normalization and complex path matching during initialization and serialization.

WHAT
* Removed the areas field from ProjectConfig struct and its JSON mapping.
* Deleted logic for initializing, writing, and resolving the areas map.
* Simplified LoadProjectConfig to ignore legacy areas.
* Updated FormatScopeContext to only return the project description.
